content_fields.title: Test package registry security (GitHub)
content_fields.description: Verify the package registry security controls.
content_fields.guidance: Verification means confirming anonymous publish is refused, that package versions are immutable, and that upstream proxying is limited to approved sources.
content_fields.found: No private registry is associated with this project.
content_fields.missing: The registry that would be the subject of the verification.
content_fields.conclusion: The verification has no subject in the current setup.
content_fields.action: The platform team should verify registry controls once a private registry exists.
